scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @autoqa/domain && npm run build --workspace @autoqa/contracts && npm run build --workspace @autoqa/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @autoqa/domain && npm run typecheck --workspace @autoqa/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @autoqa/api
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @autoqa/domain && npm run test --workspace @autoqa/contracts && npm run test --workspace @autoqa/api
scripts.format: prettier --write package.json tsconfig.base.json apps packages .github CONTRIBUTING.md README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json tsconfig.base.json apps packages .github CONTRIBUTING.md README.md
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test
